headline: Papastavrou on Heating Oil: Measures to Set Prices Households Can Afford
summary: Energy Minister Papastavrou said the expanded heating allowance will cover roughly 1,170,000 beneficiaries. Measures are intended to set heating oil prices households can afford.
why: Heating oil prices affect household budgets and inflation, and government subsidies can influence demand and fiscal spending.
